clips.title: The story
paras: Gathering Leather is a straightforward trade request offered by Veren Tallstrider on the rises of Thunder Bluff. To sustain the capital and test young hunters, Veren exchanges a bundle of cured light leather skins for crafted goods. It highlights the deeply ingrained tauren tradition of turning the fruits of the plains hunt into essential clothing and armor.

In the newly settled capital atop the high mesas of Mulgore, craftsmanship and survival walk hand in hand. Veren Tallstrider works skins into clothing and protective armor needed by the growing population of Thunder Bluff. Rather than harvesting everything himself, he encourages young adventurers heading out into the plains to bring back their quarry, turning mundane hunting into honorable civic service.

For the tauren, hunting beasts across the grasslands is not sport; it is an honorable endeavor that feeds, clothes, and shelters the tribe. Veren Tallstrider looks for hunters with a hunger to bring honor to their clan, asking specifically for light leather stripped from the local wildlife. In return for twelve well-kept hides, he repays the hunter with sturdy goods, reinforcing the mutual support that binds tauren society together.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, young one. You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt. May you bring honor to your clan!
I work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.
If you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello again. Have you been hunting? Do you have skins for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, these are very nice pieces. They'll make fine leather goods.
Here, friend. Take this in trade...
